scope: Mouse GO Biological Process enrichment for primary gene-level RNA-seq contrasts. miRNA features are intentionally excluded because no validated target mapping was supplied.

artifacts.name: mgi.gaf.gz
header: !Documentation about this header can be found here: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/docs/gaf_validation.md

artifacts.name: go-basic.obo
header: subsetdef: chebi_ph7_3 "Rhea list of ChEBI terms representing the major species at pH 7.3."
subsetdef: gocheck_do_not_annotate "Term not to be used for direct annotation"
subsetdef: goslim_euk_cellular_processes_ribbon "GO ribbon for eukaroytic cellular processes"
synonymtypedef: syngo_official_label "label approved by the SynGO project"
property_value: dc:description "The Gene Ontology (GO) provides a framework and set of concepts for describing the functions of gene products from all organisms." xsd:string

reference_sources.scope: Official GO current distribution files, frozen locally by SHA256. Header dates describe each delivered product; annotation source headers can reference older ontology builds.

annotation_audit.ontology_ID_policy: Resolve alternative IDs and obsolete IDs with exactly one replacement leading to an active BP term; ambiguous or missing replacements are excluded.
annotation_audit.synonym_field: GAF column 11 (zero-based index 10); column 10 is the descriptive name and is never used as a symbol alias.

annotation_filter: Taxon of annotated entity must be 10090; exclude NOT relations; biological_process aspect P only for gene sets; all positive annotation evidence codes retained.
propagation: Transitive closure through active BP is_a and part_of parents only; excludes regulates, positively_regulates, negatively_regulates, has_part and cross-aspect edges.
gene_identifiers: Case-sensitive exact canonical mouse symbols or uniquely resolving GAF DB Object Synonyms (column 11 / index 10). No uppercasing, orthology transfer, free-text name matching or human pathway libraries.
gene_deduplication: Map all DE features first; retain the representative feature with highest baseMean for each canonical symbol, regardless of statistic, p-value, direction or significance. Ties resolved by feature_id lexical order. All candidate decisions are exported.
ORA_universe: Unique mapped canonical gene representatives with finite adjusted DE p-value, including those without specific GO-BP annotations. Unmapped or ambiguous symbols are excluded and their coverage reported.
ORA_foreground: DE BH-adjusted p-value <0.05; up/down from the unshrunken log2 fold change sign, separately. No exploratory effect-size threshold.

term_size_filter.basis: Intersect each propagated GO-BP gene set with the ORA testable gene universe before selecting the eligible family. GSEA also enforces 15-500 members in its complete finite-statistic rank.

ORA_test: One-sided hypergeometric survival P(X>=observed overlap), using the mapped finite-adjusted-p-value gene universe. Terms with zero overlap remain in the tested family, with p=1.
ORA_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all eligible GO-BP terms, including zero overlaps, separately within each dataset and up/down family; FDR threshold 0.05.

GSEA.ranking: All unique mapped representative genes with finite unshrunken Wald statistic AND finite original Wald p-value, descending; ties resolved by gene symbol. Genes with finite raw p-value and missing adjusted p-value from independent filtering remain eligible. No FDR or effect-size selection is used.
GSEA.Cook_filter_quality_control: Nonfinite original p-values indicate Cook-filtered or otherwise unreliable DE tests and are excluded even when their Wald statistic remains finite. Excluded genes and initial exploratory ranks are preserved in the quality audit. This is a gene-test quality filter; no animal is deleted.
GSEA.permutation_type: gene-set / gene-label permutations, not phenotype permutations
GSEA.FDR: GSEA algorithmic FDR estimate based on normalized enrichment scores and permutation null distributions, not Benjamini-Hochberg. Threshold 0.05; nominal permutation p=0 or q=0 is a finite-permutation estimate, not zero error probability.
GSEA.interpretation: Exploratory association with the ranked contrast; no pathway activation, suppression or causal claim. Gene-set permutations do not account for sample-level uncertainty or preserve gene-gene correlation.

caveats: GO annotations are incomplete and unequal across genes; mapping and specific BP annotation coverage are exported.
Gene-length and detectability biases are not modeled by this classical ORA. The measured/testable universe limits but does not remove these biases.
GO terms share genes and ancestors; enriched terms are correlated and should not be counted as independent mechanisms.
Small biological sample sizes and sample heterogeneity in the source DE analyses carry into enrichment.
Input gene lists, mapping and tested term families are fixed before each enrichment test; no search over thresholds or removal of inconvenient samples is performed.

figure_captions.ORA_significant_terms: Only GO-BP terms meeting within-family BH FDR <0.05 are plotted. Parenthetical counts are overlap / foreground. Empty panels explicitly report no significant terms.
figure_captions.GSEA_terms: At most twelve lowest-q significant terms; when none pass, lowest-q terms are shown and labelled descriptive. Point position is NES and colors indicate NES direction.
figure_captions.GSEA_curve: Running weighted enrichment and gene-set hit positions along the QC-eligible finite-Wald-statistic rank with finite original p-value. One lowest-q term per NES direction is shown for exploration; its estimated algorithmic FDR is displayed.
